questions: Have you ever experienced any allergic reactions to antibiotics, particularly penicillin?
preop_note_claims: Patient has a history of obesity (BMI 28), hyperlipidemia, and well-controlled hypertension.
Current medications include Atorvastatin 20mg daily, Metformin 500mg BID, and Omeprazole 20mg daily; Simvastatin 10mg nightly was discontinued.
Patient reports a penicillin allergy (rash) not documented in medical records.
ASA-PS classification is 2 due to mild systemic disease (obesity, hyperlipidemia, hypertension).

Airway assessment indicates no anticipated difficulties; anesthetic plan includes general anesthesia with LMA, propofol induction, remifentanil infusion, vecuronium for muscle relaxation, and desflurane maintenance.
handoff_claims: Key history includes obesity (BMI 28), hyperlipidemia, hypertension, and reported penicillin allergy (rash) not documented.
Intraoperative course: Elective laparoscopic cholecystectomy under general anesthesia with LMA; medications included propofol, remifentanil infusion, vecuronium, and desflurane maintenance.

Anticipated issues: Potential for postoperative respiratory depression due to remifentanil, need for monitoring of neuromuscular function post-vecuronium, and consideration of penicillin allergy in postoperative care.
